notes.title: Dark Dragonkin Update 4/3/22
notes.content:
A few minor updates as of 4/3/22:
[list]
[*] Tutorial dialogs change a bit to note the fire immunity of the Shield Bearer Dragonkin as they are fire aspected.
[*] Fixed and issue which could cause the Shield Bearer Dragonkin to overreact to fireballs and behave strangely.  He will now ignore them.
[*] Exit Portals are now a little more generous if characters do not stand close to the middle of the portal.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 3/11/22
notes.content:
Just a few minor changes:
[list]
[*] Evelina's recovery ability has been buffed.  It heals for 60 to self and characters in the immediate area.
[*] Dante's back stab ability button now enables more precisely when he is in range to use the ability.
[*] Some back end performance updates.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 3/4/22
notes.content:
A few of the small items that litter the Dragonkin Realms have moved or been removed.  This should aid in preventing player characters sometimes getting stuck on them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin Web Comic
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/cf4456d1509f2526086e6f4239def310395277ae.png[/img]
We wanted to give a little background to how our party of adventurers arrived at the dragonkin's dungeon in in this webcomic. 

You can check it out here:  https://twintertainment.com/dark-dragonkin-web-comic

Also, take a moment to Wishlist Dark Dragonkin now!  Dark Dragonkin is an RPG adventure in which the player guides each character one at a time to the portal to exit the level.  Levels are designed so that party members must contribute unique skills to help the party through to the portal. 

[list][*]You control each character separately.
[*]Each character has their own unique skills to get past obstacles.
[*]Every Level is like an old school RPG puzzle.
[*]Even the enemies are puzzles of how to avoid or destroy them.
[*]You must figure out how to gather the party at the exit portal to advance.
[*]Powerful bosses that are a challenging puzzle to defeat to gain passage through their realm.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin 1.0.0.10
notes.content:
New build of Dark Dragonkin is available.
[list]
[*] The major change is improved redering to eliminate clipping related to depth in the scene.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Patch 1.0.0.0.9 Visual Update
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.0.0.9 is live!  This is primarily a visual update.  There are a few minor bug fixes as well as a revamp for the dreaded level 17 to bring it in line with the difficulty of one of the introductory levels.  The Three-star time for the revamped level have been reduced.  Current ratings and achievements will not change from the previous patch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin Patch 9/19/2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Evelina's heal spell has been buffed.  Now call recovery, it will heal near by player characters as well as reviving them if they were knocked out.
[*] Small change to the tutorial to help with the flow of on boarding players.
[*] Enemy AI update that will prevent rare collision issues that could cause the level to need to be restarted.
[*] Fire Breathing Dragonkin update to avoid unwanted collisions with the new side perspective treasure chest.
[*] Minor visual corrections to some of the levels.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin 1.0.0.0.8 Game Patch 9/12/21
notes.content:
Achievements are now live.

A number of graphical improvements:
[list]
[*] drop shadows
[*] idle animations
[*] treasure chest that more closely match the mimics.
[/list]

There have been some small changes to levels to accommodate changed artwork.

Minor bug fixes mostly around corrected dialog text or visibility. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin 1.0.0.07 Update Content update
notes.content:

[list]
[*] All level content is now available for testers, influencers and press contacts!
[*] Improvements to the first level tutorial to help get players up to speed faster and clearer.
[*] Corrected and error that could sometime make the characters portrait appear at the bottom instead of the top of the dialog.
[*] Corrected Evelina's Flutter wording to make it flow a little better.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin 1.0.0.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
A few updates for 1.0.0.05.

Main update is corner clipping for objects bumped my Rose's shield charge.  This will make puzzles involving bumping things around easier to get them where you want them.

There are a we other bug fixes mostly with enemies crossing bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/44d4f11359d10758d7d6e7ec3649ee8584005a60.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dark Dragonkin Patch 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes 1.0.0.4[/h1]

[h2]Skill Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced cooldowns
[*] Fairy Form continues to flutter while not moving now.
[*] Counter now has arcane splash when countering enemy spells.
[*] Backstab will more accurately indicate when it is available.
[/list]

[h2]Updates and Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] GUI now looks more retro.
[*] Color indicators for health status
[*] Level collision fixes.
[*] Bridge fixes when the bridge opens.
[*] Corner gliding.  No getting stuck on corners.
[*] Level increase for full users
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38938471/d87a3e95e4b340960f4d51bf8455d218d876d521.png[/img]
